description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseMessage' used as a common superclass for API request messages within the 'Microsoft.eShopWeb.PublicApi' namespace. It includes a protected Guid '_correlationId' initialized with a new GUID and a public method 'CorrelationId()' to retrieve this ID.

classes.name: BaseMessage
classes.description: An abstract base class for API requests that contains a correlation ID used for logging and tracking requests.

methods.name: CorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID associated with the message for logging or tracking purposes.
